Evidence labels

VERIFIED
Supported directly by the linked source.
INFERENCE
A reasoned interpretation of verified evidence.
PROPOSAL
An original editorial or design recommendation.
UNRESOLVED
Requires reporting, permission, legal review, or confirmation.

Asset rule

No AI-generated imagery. A visual enters the exhibition only with an object-level title, creator or institution, canonical URL, date, identifier, evidentiary use, rights statement, credit, retrieval date, alt text, and local implementation decision.
